starter.location: front of the crankcase, bottom, LEFT side; pad just aft of the propeller-end main bearing boss; motor axis parallel to the crankshaft, pinion forward to the ring gear

alternator.location: front, lower RIGHT side: bracket 07A21443 on the bottom of the crankcase near the front, adjusting link LW-10729 to the front right of the case, belt-driven from the ring-gear support pulley
